task: Compare arithmetic, geometric and harmonic means
task_zh: 比较算术、几何与调和均值
detail: Returns the three point estimates for positive nonmissing values; Stata also reports their confidence intervals.
detail_zh: 对非缺失正值返回三种点估计；Stata还报告相应置信区间。
meaning: compare arithmetic, geometric and harmonic means

task: Estimate a median and bootstrap its confidence interval
task_zh: 估计中位数并自助计算置信区间
detail: Point-estimate correspondence; this uses a percentile bootstrap interval, whereas Stata centile defaults to a binomial order-statistic interval.
detail_zh: 点估计对应；此例使用百分位自助区间，而Stata的centile默认使用基于二项分布的顺序统计量区间。
meaning: estimate a median and bootstrap its confidence interval

task: Estimate Cohen standardized mean differences for two independent groups
task_zh: 估计两个独立组的Cohen标准化均值差
detail: Uses pooled SD and first-group minus second-group direction; reverse the sign if the substantive contrast is reversed.
detail_zh: 使用合并标准差，方向为第一组减第二组；若研究对比方向相反，应改变符号。
setup: set.seed(31415); data <- data.frame(g=factor(rep(c("a","b","c"),each=30))); data$y <- stats::rnorm(90,mean=rep(c(0,0.5,1),each=30),sd=1); data <- data[data$g!="c",]; data$g <- droplevels(data$g)
meaning: estimate cohen standardized mean differences for two independent groups

task: Compute a pooled-SD effect size from group summaries
task_zh: 根据组汇总统计量计算合并标准差效应量
detail: Fixed summary-statistic workflow returns Cohen d only; confidence intervals and Hedges correction are not included.
detail_zh: 固定汇总统计量流程仅返回Cohen d；未计算置信区间或Hedges校正。
meaning: compute a pooled-sd effect size from group summaries

task: Test equal group variances using median-centered Levene inference
task_zh: 使用以中位数为中心的Levene方法检验组间方差相等
detail: Corresponds to robvar W50; Stata additionally reports mean-centered W0 and 10-percent-trimmed W10.
detail_zh: 对应robvar的W50；Stata另外报告以均值为中心的W0和以10%截尾均值为中心的W10。
meaning: test equal group variances using median-centered levene inference

r: { above <- data$y>0; n1 <- sum(above); n0 <- sum(!above); runs <- 1+sum(diff(above)!=0); expected <- 1+2*n1*n0/(n1+n0); variance <- 2*n1*n0*(2*n1*n0-n1-n0)/((n1+n0)^2*(n1+n0-1)); z <- (runs-expected)/sqrt(variance); c(runs=runs,z=z,p.value=2*stats::pnorm(-abs(z))) }
task: Test whether a binary threshold sequence has random runs
task_zh: 检验阈值二分序列的游程是否随机
detail: Uses the large-sample uncorrected runs statistic, matching Stata default continuity convention; missing values must be removed before this workflow.
detail_zh: 使用大样本无连续性校正的游程统计量，对应Stata默认约定；使用此流程前需删除缺失值。
meaning: test whether a binary threshold sequence has random runs

task: Test matched-table symmetry directly from cell counts
task_zh: 根据单元格计数直接检验匹配表对称性
detail: For this 2-by-2 table the symmetry test is the uncorrected McNemar test. Stata also reports table summaries; this R result is an htest object.
detail_zh: 对此2乘2表，对称性检验是未作连续性修正的McNemar检验。Stata还报告表格汇总；R返回htest对象。
meaning: test matched-table symmetry directly from cell counts

task: Test a factor term in a fitted multivariate model
task_zh: 检验已拟合多变量模型中的因子项
detail: After fitting the corresponding MANOVA model. This R row extracts Pillai; Stata manovatest reports four multivariate statistics.
detail_zh: 先拟合对应MANOVA模型。此R示例提取Pillai统计量；Stata的manovatest报告四种多变量统计量。
meaning: test a factor term in a fitted multivariate model

task: Estimate a one-way individual-measure intraclass correlation
task_zh: 估计单向模型单次测量组内相关
detail: Fixed balanced design has three measurements per target. R starts from wide repeated-measure columns; ICC1 is the one-way absolute-agreement individual-measure form.
detail_zh: 固定平衡设计中每个对象有三次测量。R从宽格式重复测量列开始；ICC1为单向绝对一致性的单次测量形式。
setup: set.seed(31415); data <- expand.grid(id=seq_len(30),rater=seq_len(3)); subject <- stats::rnorm(30); data$y <- subject[data$id]+stats::rnorm(90,sd=0.5)
meaning: estimate a one-way individual-measure intraclass correlation

task: Orthogonalize centered predictor columns in their stated order
task_zh: 按指定顺序对中心化解释变量列正交化
detail: Unweighted QR gives an orthogonal basis with mean square one; signs can differ from Stata modified Gram-Schmidt output.
detail_zh: 无权重QR给出均方为一的正交基；符号可能与Stata改进Gram-Schmidt输出不同。
meaning: orthogonalize centered predictor columns in their stated order

stata: orthpoly x, generate(p1 p2 p3) degree(3)
task: Construct three orthogonal polynomial columns
task_zh: 生成三个正交多项式变量列
detail: Rescales the R orthonormal basis to mean square one; polynomial signs and stored coefficient conventions may differ.
detail_zh: 把R的标准正交基缩放为均方一；多项式符号与所保存系数的约定可能不同。
meaning: construct three orthogonal polynomial columns

task: Compare successively added regression blocks
task_zh: 比较逐步加入的回归变量块
detail: Compares these two nested OLS fits with a partial F test; it does not implement the general Stata prefix that sequences arbitrary model blocks.
detail_zh: 用偏F检验比较这两个嵌套OLS模型；不实现Stata前缀按任意模型块逐步拟合的一般功能。
meaning: compare successively added regression blocks

task: Form group contrasts against the reference category
task_zh: 构造各组与参照类别之间的对比
detail: Returns contrast estimates and covariance. Stata contrast defaults to unadjusted tests; summary(glht) defaults to single-step multiplicity adjustment. Use summary(result, test=multcomp::adjusted("none")) for unadjusted p-values.
detail_zh: 返回对比估计与协方差。Stata的contrast默认不调整多重检验；summary(glht)默认采用single-step调整。未调整p值应使用summary(result, test=multcomp::adjusted("none"))。
meaning: form group contrasts against the reference category

task: Compare all group pairs with Tukey simultaneous intervals
task_zh: 通过Tukey同时置信区间比较全部组对
detail: After the one-way equal-variance model y on g; R TukeyHSD is not a general replacement for adjusted margins in arbitrary models.
detail_zh: 适用于y对g的单因素等方差模型；R的TukeyHSD不能普遍替代任意模型的调整后边际比较。
meaning: compare all group pairs with tukey simultaneous intervals

task: Compare group means using Bonferroni-adjusted pooled tests
task_zh: 使用Bonferroni校正的合并方差检验比较组均值
detail: Uses a common pooled within-group variance and Bonferroni-adjusted pairwise t tests. The returned p-value matrix does not include Stata pairwise mean-difference confidence intervals.
detail_zh: 采用共同的组内合并方差及Bonferroni调整的成对t检验。返回p值矩阵，不含Stata的成对均值差置信区间。
meaning: compare group means using bonferroni-adjusted pooled tests

r: { pred <- stats::predict(fit,type="link",se.fit=TRUE); data$p <- stats::plogis(pred$fit); data$se <- data$p*(1-data$p)*pred$se.fit; data[c("p","se")] }
task: Apply a nonlinear prediction transform with delta-method standard errors
task_zh: 对预测作非线性变换并计算Delta方法标准误
detail: Run after a logit GLM. This uses the derivative p*(1-p) and the fitted linear-index standard error.
detail_zh: 在logit广义线性模型后使用；采用导数p*(1-p)和拟合线性指数标准误。
meaning: apply a nonlinear prediction transform with delta-method standard errors

task: Fit cross-validated lasso linear prediction
task_zh: 拟合交叉验证的lasso线性预测模型
detail: Prediction workflow: folds, standardization, penalty grids, loss scaling and lambda selection differ from Stata defaults; coefficients need not match.
detail_zh: 预测流程对应：折分、标准化、惩罚网格、损失缩放和lambda选择与Stata默认值不同，系数不保证相同。
meaning: fit cross-validated lasso linear prediction

stata: elasticnet linear y x z, alpha(0.5)
task: Fit cross-validated elasticnet linear prediction
task_zh: 拟合交叉验证的elasticnet线性预测模型
detail: Prediction workflow: folds, standardization, penalty grids, loss scaling and lambda selection differ from Stata defaults; coefficients need not match.
detail_zh: 预测流程对应：折分、标准化、惩罚网格、损失缩放和lambda选择与Stata默认值不同，系数不保证相同。
meaning: fit cross-validated elasticnet linear prediction

task: Test a mean using a known population standard deviation
task_zh: 使用已知总体标准差检验均值
detail: The value 3 is assumed known as a population SD, not estimated from the sample.
detail_zh: 数值3假定为已知总体标准差，而非样本估计值。
meaning: test a mean using a known population standard deviation

task: Compare independent means from known-variance summaries
task_zh: 根据已知方差汇总量比较独立均值
detail: Treats the supplied standard deviations as known and uses a normal reference distribution. Returns the z statistic and two-sided p-value, without Stata confidence limits.
detail_zh: 将给定标准差视为已知，并采用正态参考分布。返回z统计量和双侧p值，不含Stata置信限。
meaning: compare independent means from known-variance summaries

task: Fit zero-truncated Poisson regression
task_zh: 拟合零截断泊松回归
detail: Zero-truncation only: fitted values are conditional positive-count means, while log-link coefficients parameterize the latent Poisson lambda.
detail_zh: 仅对应零截断；拟合值为给定正计数条件下的均值，而对数连接系数参数化的是潜在泊松lambda。
setup: set.seed(31415); data <- data.frame(x=stats::rnorm(600)); data$y <- stats::rpois(600,exp(0.7+0.3*data$x)); data <- data[data$y>0,]
meaning: fit zero-truncated poisson regression

task: Fit zero-truncated NB2 regression
task_zh: 拟合零截断NB2回归
detail: Zero-truncated NB2 with constant size; VGAM size equals 1/alpha. Information-matrix and optimizer conventions can differ.
detail_zh: 零截断NB2采用固定size参数；VGAM的size等于1/alpha。信息矩阵和优化约定可能不同。
setup: set.seed(31415); data <- data.frame(x=stats::rnorm(700)); data$y <- stats::rnbinom(700,mu=exp(0.7+0.3*data$x),size=2); data <- data[data$y>0,]
meaning: fit zero-truncated nb2 regression

task: Fit a right-censored Poisson count model
task_zh: 拟合右删失泊松计数模型
detail: Fixed right-censoring limit 4; status is one for exact counts and zero for counts known to be at least 4. Censoring must not be treated as truncation.
detail_zh: 固定右删失界限为4；精确计数的status为1，已知计数至少为4时为0。删失不能按截断处理。
setup: set.seed(31415); data <- data.frame(x=stats::rnorm(600)); latent <- stats::rpois(600,exp(0.7+0.3*data$x)); data$y <- pmin(latent,4); data$status <- as.integer(latent<4)
meaning: fit a right-censored poisson count model

task: Fit jointly correlated binary probit equations
task_zh: 联合拟合相关的二元probit方程
detail: Both binary equations share x and use a constant latent correlation; rho link parameterizations differ but fitted joint probabilities have the same model meaning.
detail_zh: 两个二元方程共享x并采用固定潜在相关；rho连接参数化不同，但拟合联合概率具有相同模型含义。
setup: set.seed(31415); data <- data.frame(x=stats::rnorm(500)); errors <- MASS::mvrnorm(500,mu=c(0,0),Sigma=matrix(c(1,0.4,0.4,1),2)); data$y1 <- as.integer(0.3+0.4*data$x+errors[,1]>0); data$y2 <- as.integer(-0.2+0.3*data$x+errors[,2]>0)
meaning: fit jointly correlated binary probit equations

task: Fit a zero-left-truncated normal regression
task_zh: 拟合在零处左截断的正态回归
detail: VGAM posnormal represents the special case of normal observations selected above zero; this example does not cover varying or upper truncation limits.
detail_zh: VGAM的posnormal对应仅观察到大于零正态结果的特例；此例不覆盖变动界限或上截断。
setup: set.seed(31415); data <- data.frame(x=stats::rnorm(700)); data$y <- 0.7+0.3*data$x+stats::rnorm(700); data <- data[data$y>0,]
check: stopifnot({ eta <- VGAM::predict(.result,type="link"); mu <- eta[,1]; sigma <- exp(eta[,2]); expected <- sum(stats::dnorm(data$y,mu,sigma,log=TRUE)-stats::pnorm(0,mu,sigma,lower.tail=FALSE,log.p=TRUE)); length(VGAM::coef(.result))==3 && abs(as.numeric(VGAM::logLik(.result))-expected)<1e-6 })
meaning: fit a zero-left-truncated normal regression

stata: slogit y x z, dimension(1) baseoutcome(3)
task: Fit a rank-one stereotype multinomial logit model
task_zh: 拟合秩一刻板多项logit模型
detail: Uses the reduced-rank multinomial-logit form of the one-dimensional Anderson stereotype model. Category score identification, scale and sign conventions can differ.
detail_zh: 采用一维Anderson刻板模型的降秩多项logit形式。类别得分的识别、尺度与符号约定可能不同。
setup: set.seed(31415); data <- data.frame(x=stats::rnorm(600),z=stats::rnorm(600)); score <- 0.5*data$x-0.3*data$z; weights <- cbind(exp(-0.2+score),exp(0.3+0.4*score),1); probabilities <- weights/rowSums(weights); u <- stats::runif(600); data$y <- factor(ifelse(u<probabilities[,1],"1",ifelse(u<rowSums(probabilities[,1:2]),"2","3")))
meaning: fit a rank-one stereotype multinomial logit model
